create_rollout_storage: create a RolloutStorage instance to buffer observations, actions, rewards, and value predictions for RL training
insert_rollout_step_data: insert step data including observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the RolloutStorage buffers
compute_returns_with_gae: compute discounted returns using GAE or standard bootstrapping on stored rewards and value predictions
generate_training_minibatches: generate shuffled mini-batches of rollout data with RNN sequence info for PPO training updates
move_storage_to_device: move all RolloutStorage buffers from CPU to GPU or between devices for training
